design_rationale:
# Task 0 dossier — refinance into a longer term (Renee Calloway, Ohio, Grade C, frozen 2026-10-20 11:15 EDT)

## Draw and scope
draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems 1, factor_counts [6, 4]. Root loan_ext_refi_application (6 factors,
user tool submit_refinance_application_9ec5cb64); prerequisite loan_ext_refi_payoff_quote (4 factors, agent tool
issue_payoff_quote_88f1b45e). Task 1 claims the other four policies; scopes are disjoint and jointly complete.

## Why this is a good test
Renee asks only to refinance her loan over 48 months with no cash out. The refinance rule's prerequisite sentence
("The amount financed on a refinance application is fixed only after the loan being refinanced carries a
refinance-purpose payoff quote dated on the application date.") points at a quote the records do not have (refinance
quotes of 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-05, a borrower_payoff quote of 2026-10-12). The agent must issue that quote with four
record-driven rules (window anchor on AutoPay and the next due date, day-rate split after the 2026-10-18 AutoPay
cancellation, hold on the not-yet-returned 2026-10-16 online extra payment, re-quote cushion), then size the application
from it with six rules (sizing form for a loan that is itself a recent refinance, remaining-term credit, payment-record,
AutoPay, FlexLine and Credit Builder credits) and hand the application to Renee to submit herself.

## Problem-tree card
Edge R <- Q: value_input, gate r_payoff, form state, affirmative ("only after"); record-visible state
(loan_payoff_quotes purpose/quote date); no tool, id or code token; scope = one refinance quote dated today. Only
issue_payoff_quote_88f1b45e writes payoff quotes, and the refinance-quote policy is the one whose rule issues
refinance-purpose quotes -> one resolving action. Unmet at the opening (no refinance quote dated 2026-10-20). Order:
quote (step 12) then application (step 14). Skip effect: no payoff to be covered; sizing from the stale 2026-10-05
quote (payoff 6379.24) would request 6459 instead of 6519. user_scenario names no quote or first step; both
tools only create a row from their arguments.

## Base-invariant card
Quote: active_loan (active); one_quote_per_day_purpose (no refinance quote dated 2026-10-20). Application:
open_loan_cap (one open loan; the 2023 loan is paid_off), no_charged_off_loan, existing_loan_current (past due 0.00),
state_available (OH), age_of_majority (time; DOB 1986-05-09, 216 calendar months, inclusive: in time from 2004-05-09),
old_loan_active, seasoning (time; funded 2025-06-20, Grade C 6 whole months, inclusive: refused 2025-12-19, in time
from 2025-12-20; 16 months at frozen_time), old_loan_standing (past due 0.00; only hardship plan an expired 2026-01
deferral offer; 15 consecutive on-time installments — the September 2025 installment was cured on 2025-10-02 inside its
grace period).

## Factor card (handling-time run; each factor's baseline figure)
Quote 6438.42 (all baselines 6012.47): window_anchor_rule (method; AutoPay off, next due in 5 days -> window to the end
of the 15-day grace: 20 days, good through 2026-11-09; baseline 10 days -> 6414.68); day_rate_split (method;
cancellation 2026-10-18 after paid-through 2026-10-16 -> 2 days at 13.99; baseline -> 6438.58);
uncleared_payment_hold (parameter; 400.00 online ACH 2026-10-16, not returned, no return in 12 whole months -> 5-day
hold, added back; baseline -> 6038.42; near-miss: the 2025-09-29 return is exactly 12 whole months old);
requote_cushion (parameter; one refinance quote fewer than one whole month old -> 1 day; baseline -> 6436.04;
near-misses: 2026-09-14 quote, 2026-10-12 borrower_payoff quote).
Application 6519 (all baselines 6637): refi_sizing_form (method; itself a refinance funded 16 whole months ago -> fee
on the payoff added on top; baseline withheld -> 6520); remaining_term_credit (parameter; 21 installments
remain -> 0.25; baseline -> 6535); payment_record_credit (15 counted, no late fee in 24 months -> 0.50;
baseline -> 6551; near-miss: the paid-off loan's 2024 late fee); autopay_record_credit (12 AutoPay debits,
none returned in 12 whole months -> 0.25; baseline -> 6535); flexline_standing_credit (cross line;
FlexLine opened 2025-01-15, its 2025-08-21 late fee 13 whole months old -> 0.50; baseline -> 6551);
credit_builder_credit (cross builder; matured 2022-11-16 -> 0.25; baseline -> 6535). Fee percent 3.99 -
1.00 - 0.25 - 0.50 - 0.25 - 0.50 - 0.25 = 1.24; 6438.42 x 1.0124 = 6518.26 -> 6519.

## World rows
Customer, Huntington (every payment so far) and Ally (linked 2026-10-14) checking accounts; the paid-off 2023 loan
(its late fee and return are near-misses); the active 2025 refinance loan with fields equal to its ledger replay
(principal 5979.24, paid through 2026-10-16, next due 2026-10-25, AutoPay off, current 14.49); 15 AutoPay installments,
the 2025-09-25 debit returned R01 with its fee and cured 2025-10-02, extra payments of 2026-06-05 and 2026-10-16;
servicing events (enrollment 2025-06-20, borrower cancellation 2026-10-18); three earlier quotes, each worked out under
the rules in force on its date (the 2026-10-05 refinance quote carries its one-day re-quote cushion); the expired
deferral offer; FlexLine Standard and its ledger; the matured Credit Builder account. No stale cache; no automatic
clause pending.

## Persona
Plain and a little tired; volunteers only the refinance goal; gives phone, DOB, ZIP one at a time; term 48, no cash
out, Ohio, bank switch and other Larkspur accounts only when asked; submits the application exactly as handed; ends on
the submission's return. Names no quote and no prerequisite.

## Standard solution
find_customers -> verify -> find_loans -> find_loan_transactions -> find_bank_accounts -> find_loan_servicing_events
-> find_loan_payoff_quotes -> find_hardship_plans -> find_credit_lines -> find_line_transactions -> find_builder_accounts
-> issue_payoff_quote_88f1b45e(loan, customer, refinance, 2026-11-09, 6438.42) -> Renee: submit_refinance_application_9ec5cb64(
customer, loan, Personal Loan Grade C, OH, 48, 6519). The scratch harness replays the writes through the real tools,
evaluates each compute on its handling-time world and substitutes every factor baseline; check_compute recomputes the
same figures.

## Draft recomputation from the visible context
The refinance rule points at a refinance quote dated today; none exists. Quote: window 20 (AutoPay off, due in 5 days,
grace 15), cushion 1, 2 days at 13.99, 400.00 held -> 6438.42. Application: fee 1.24% added on top -> 6519. Same as
gold; the stated tie rules and the whole-month convention settle the boundary rows.
user_scenario: You are Renee Calloway, 40, an office manager at a dental practice in Columbus, Ohio. You took a Larkspur personal loan in June 2025 that paid off your older Larkspur loan, and your hours at work were cut this fall, so the monthly payment of $357.93 has become hard to carry. You are calling Larkspur today because you want to refinance that loan with Larkspur into a longer term so the monthly payment drops; you have decided on a 48-month term and you do not want any extra cash out of it, only to replace the loan you have. You speak plainly, a little tired, and you like to understand what you are agreeing to before you do it. You open by saying you would like to refinance your Larkspur loan over a longer term to get the payment down. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give your mobile number 6145551294, your date of birth 1986-05-09 and your ZIP code 43212, one at a time as they are asked for; your email, if asked, is renee.calloway@outlook.com. You do not know your customer number or your loan number. If the agent asks which term you want, you say 48 months; if asked whether you want any cash back, you say no, just the old loan paid off; if asked where you live, you say Columbus, Ohio, at the same address Larkspur has on file. If the agent asks about AutoPay or your bank, you explain that you switched banks: you opened a checking account with Ally Bank last week, you turned off AutoPay from your Huntington account in the app on Sunday, and you made a $400 extra payment from Huntington last Friday before moving your money; you plan to set up payments on the new loan yourself once it exists, and you are not asking for anything on that today. If the agent asks whether you have other accounts with Larkspur, you mention a FlexLine you use now and then and the Credit Builder account you finished a few years ago. You do not know how Larkspur works out the new loan amount or the fees, and you do not suggest any figures. When the agent explains that the refinance application has to be submitted by you, and hands it over to you with the details to enter, you submit it once, exactly as the agent gives you: your customer number, the loan being paid off, the grade, the state, the 48-month term and the amount financed the agent states. If the agent tells you an amount financed without explaining it, you ask once what it covers, and accept the agent's explanation. Once your submission comes back showing the application recorded, you thank the agent and end the call; you do not ask for anything else.

request_binding.action_semantics: Replacing an existing Larkspur loan with a new Larkspur loan is a refinance application (loan purpose refinance_existing_loan) and the borrower consents by submitting it herself; a second concurrent loan or a payoff would not replace the loan.

base_preconditions.condition: The borrower holds fewer than the maximum number of open personal loans, not counting the loan a refinance application will pay off.
No personal loan of the borrower is in charged_off status.
The existing active loan has an amount past due of 0.00.
The applicant's state of residence on the profile is not one of the unavailable states.
The applicant's date of birth is at least the state's minimum age before the application date, using the minimum ages by state in minimum_age_years.
The loan being refinanced must be in active status.
The application is taken only when the current date is at least the refinance minimum months after the funding date of the loan being refinanced.

The loan being refinanced has an amount past due of 0.00, no hardship plan on it is in requested, offered or active status, and its most recent consecutive on-time installments number at least the refinance minimum of its grade.

temporal_feasibility.condition: The applicant's date of birth is at least the state's minimum age before the application date, using the minimum ages by state in minimum_age_years.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: An age of N years is counted as N times 12 calendar months from the date of birth, and a 29 February birthday falls on 28 February in a non-leap year.

boundary_check.just_before: Renee was born 1986-05-09 profile state OH (minimum age 18 = 216 calendar months); she reached it on 2004-05-09, so an application dated 2004-05-08 would be refused.
boundary_check.at_boundary: An application dated exactly 2004-05-09 is in time (inclusive); on 2026-10-20 she is 40, far past the boundary.

temporal_feasibility.condition: The application is taken only when the current date is at least the refinance minimum months after the funding date of the loan being refinanced.

temporal_basis.anchor_event: the funding date of the loan being refinanced
temporal_basis.counting_rule: Months are counted as whole calendar months from the funding date, and when the later month has no matching day the last day of that month is used.

boundary_check.just_before: Grade C needs 6 whole calendar months from the funding date 2025-06-20; an application dated 2025-12-19 would be refused (5 whole months).
boundary_check.at_boundary: An application dated 2025-12-20 is in time (inclusive); on 2026-10-20 the loan is 16 whole months old.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate Renee Calloway's profile by the mobile number she gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and both writes need her customer reference number, which only the profile lookup returns.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with three matching credentials: mobile number, date of birth and ZIP code.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No loan detail may be discussed and no quote or application recorded before identity verification passes.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her loans: the active Grade C refinance loan (funding date, loan purpose, next due date, maturity date, AutoPay flag, rates, balances) and the paid-off 2023 loan.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The refinance needs the loan being refinanced, its grade and standing; the quote window reads its next due date and AutoPay flag; the sizing form reads its loan purpose and funding date and the remaining-term credit its next due date and maturity date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her loan ledgers (both loans); the active loan carries the 15 AutoPay installments, the September 2025 returned AutoPay debit and its fee, the October 2025 online installment, the June and October 2026 extra payments.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The extra-payment hold reads the latest additional-principal payment and the returned payments of the last 12 months; the payment-record and AutoPay credits count installment payments, returns, late fees and AutoPay debits; the consecutive on-time installments of the refinance eligibility come from the same rows.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her linked bank accounts: Huntington checking ending 1528 (verified, the account of every payment so far) and Ally checking ending 1903 (verified 2026-10-14).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The extra payment the hold looks at was debited from the Huntington account she is moving away from; the ledger lines point at these accounts.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the AutoPay record of the active loan: enrollment on 2025-06-20 and the borrower's cancellation on 2026-10-18.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The rate each interest day carries on the refinance quote is the rate in force that day, read from the latest AutoPay enrollment and latest AutoPay cancellation; here the interest paid-through date 2026-10-16 is under two whole months old and the only AutoPay record in the two whole months before the quote date is the 2026-10-18 cancellation, so this policy issues the quote.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the payoff quotes already issued on the active loan: refinance quotes of 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-05 and a borrower-payoff quote of 2026-10-12.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The funding cushion counts refinance-purpose quotes issued in the month before today, and the one-quote-per-day dedup gate needs to see that none is dated today.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read hardship plans on the active loan: one Short-Term Payment Deferral offer that expired in January 2026.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The refinance can be taken only if no hardship plan on the loan is requested, offered or active; the expired offer shows none is.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her FlexLine: FlexLine Standard, active, opened 2025-01-15.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The FlexLine credit on the refinance fee is decided by an active FlexLine's open date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the FlexLine ledger, including the late fee of 2025-08-21.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The FlexLine credit requires no FlexLine late fee fewer than 12 whole months before today; the August 2025 late fee is 13 months old.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her Credit Builder accounts: a Credit Builder 1200 Plan that matured on 2022-11-16.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The Credit Builder credit on the refinance fee is decided by a matured Credit Builder account.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the refinance payoff quote tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for the quote; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record the refinance-purpose payoff quote dated today on the active loan.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The amount financed on the refinance application is fixed only after the loan carries a refinance-purpose quote dated on the application date; loan_ext_refi_payoff_quote computes payoff_amount.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.loan_id: Value 647876d1-6817-4085-91e5-f1fa90b920c0. Basis: find_loans returns it as the loan_id of Renee's only active loan (status active, Personal Loan Grade C); the quote tool docstring: 'reference number of the personal loan being quoted, as returned by the loan lookup'. Uniqueness: her other loan 0031d905-c7e9-4816-9e7b-da66f5f6395b is paid_off and cannot be quoted ('Payoff quotes are issued only for a loan in active status').
argument_uniqueness_tracing.customer_id: Value c3cbea7c-202d-4c6b-b826-8de2d760c7ee. Basis: find_customers by her mobile number 6145551294 returns this customer_id, verified at step 1; the docstring asks for 'reference number of the borrower who owns that loan, as returned by the customer profile lookup'. Uniqueness: the loan's customer_id field is the same id.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.quote_purpose: Value refinance. Basis: base loan_evt_payoff_quote 'A quote for a refinance with Larkspur uses the purpose refinance.' and the refinance application rule's 'refinance-purpose payoff quote dated on the application date'; docstring 'refinance - a Larkspur refinance loan will pay the loan off by internal transfer'. Uniqueness: borrower_payoff applies when the borrower pays directly, third_party_lender when another lender pays; Renee is refinancing with Larkspur.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.good_through_date: Value 2026-11-09. Basis: the quote rule 'the good-through date is the quote date plus the quote window set below' with the window tier 'when AutoPay is off and the next due date falls 1 to payoff_quote_validity_days days after the quote date, the window runs to the last day of that installment's late-fee grace period'. AutoPay is off (cancelled 2026-10-18), next_due_date 2026-10-25 is 5 days after 2026-10-20, Grade C grace 15 days -> window 20 days -> 2026-11-09. Uniqueness: the AutoPay-on tier needs AutoPay on; the default 10 days applies only when the next due date is not 1 to 10 days away.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payoff_amount: Value 6438.42. Factors: window 5 + 15 = 20 days (AutoPay off, next due 2026-10-25, grace 15); cushion 1 day (one refinance quote, 2026-10-05, fewer than one whole month old; the 2026-09-14 one is a whole month old and the 2026-10-12 one is borrower_payoff); interest days = 4 (paid-through 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-20) + 20 + 1 = 25; day rates: the 2 days to the 2026-10-18 AutoPay cancellation at 14.49 - 0.50, the rest at 14.49 (adjustment -1.00 rate-days); interest = 5979.24 x (14.49 x 25 - 1.00) / 36500 = 59.18; hold: the latest additional-principal payment is the 400.00 online ACH of 2026-10-16, not returned, no return on the loan fewer than 12 whole months before -> 5-day hold, 4 days old -> 400.00 added back; payoff = 5979.24 + 59.18 + 0.00 + 400.00 = 6438.42.
